scope: Vehicle landspeed reacts with pre-departure embarkation, post-arrival disembarkation, costs fixed before boarding, carried crew, drain prevention and successful/failed Sense cancellation.
method: Vehicles and crew deploy through actual GEMP actions. Locations, Force, opposing Vader and top Sense destiny are controlled fixtures. Reactions, embarking, disembarking and Sense use production actions.

Seven native command sequences compare every recorded result, with JSON recovery at each command. Original passengers carried along do not consume their own regular movement or react history; cards embarking/disembarking do participate.
Cancellation preserves paid cost and completed boarding, prevents further crew windows, and locks the vehicle and embarking Luke, while the original driver remains unlocked.
limitations: Component coverage only: production full-card/deck admission remains closed.

Native-only additional checks cover battle entry, Ubrikkian, intermediate driver loss, departed/returned crew, several crew/capacity, per-turn history, prohibited transit and three responsive recovery flows. No claim these all have fresh GEMP comparisons.

Successful-react physical restrictions follow AR p170. The seven recorded observations compare restrictions after cancellation only. General vehicle/ship react grants, cargo embark/disembark around movement, deploy reacts and aboard movement Interrupts remain required.
Existing AR-versus-GEMP persistent drain cancellation discrepancy remains documented in the earlier react cancellation fixture. No new standalone Rules Lab study.
